title: Container With Most Water

content.problemStatement:
Given an integer array height, find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container that holds the most water. Return the maximum area.
![image](https://s3.amazonaws.com/hr-assets/0/1772269412-44b89d3fc8-IMG-20260228-WA0033.jpg)

solution.approach: Two-pointer approach finding maximum area min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l) moving the shorter line.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
    if toks:
        n = toks[0]
        h = toks[1:1+n]
        l, r = 0, n - 1
        max_area = 0
        while l < r:
            max_area = max(max_area, min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l))
            if h[l] < h[r]: l += 1
            else: r -= 1
        print(max_area)
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

editorial.overview: Start with left = 0, right = N - 1. Calculate area, update max area, and advance pointer with smaller height.
editorial.approach: Two-pointer approach finding maximum area min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l) moving the shorter line.
